This '''Rebel''' fought during an [[Battle of the Vehemence|attack]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vehemence (Star Destroyer)|''Vehemence'']] as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Flight leader/Legends|flight leader]] [[Wilkins]]' [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. Wilkins' [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] started an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] attack run on the ''Vehemence'', during which the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was blinded in an explosion. A damaged [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] then rammed the Y-wing, knocking Wilkins and the gunner unconscious. [[BXET-R2]], Wilkins' [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] guided the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] away from the [[Bomber/Legends|bomber's]] counterattack path, and fired a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] at the bomber, distracting it and giving time for the Y-wing to escape.
